measured_findings: Same-job resume14 ran the integrated reporter and independent reviewer. The reviewer returned seven changes_requested findings. The reporter revision failed with ReportContractError/report_evidence_ref_not_allowed because evidence_ref contained Markdown labels and multiple links instead of one exact allowed path. It is not acceptable as the final report.

The terminal reconciler marked the persisted investigation result missing because the valid, hash-bound attempt status was handoff_accepted while the successful-output branch accepted only complete. The result.json was persisted with matching output_sha256.

The untracked local report file hashes to the same HTML SHA as resume14 remote-readback fallback result 421c1d5bf69cb5371b9fa2984abf66a17eec8650e1762cf8371193d5b8098dcf; it is the unaccepted controller fallback, not a final report.
The failure handoff path must remain strict and continue to require failed/not_performed/unknown with exact identity and verified output.
